summary: Expand the private gesture across the entire keyboard and offer Apple-inspired control accents.

changes.title: Continuous keyboard password gesture
changes.detail: Only the initial touch must be below Space between Emoji and mic. The root captures the entire single-finger stroke across keys and does not forward cancelled or rejected tails to swipe typing. Full-keyboard practice enrollment and tests for stream ownership and trigger region.

changes.title: Apple accent palette
changes.detail: Choose wallpaper automatic or any of 12 Apple-inspired colors in Appearance. Extend accent to Shift, Delete, 123, Return and other control keys; keep letters, punctuation, space and glass neutral. Preserve action-only option.

changes.title: Illustrated rounded rectangles
changes.detail: Uniform rounded keycaps on the frosted keyboard preserve the existing key layout, opacity, press states and touch targets. Optional switch restores the old renderer. Physical Reno10 visual and security acceptance remain pending.
